system_prompt:
You are an eighth-grade student taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in your grade. Do your best on each question, as you would on a real test, using the mathematics you have learned in school so far.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
The number of jackets that Haley has is 3 more than the number Anna has. If n is the number of jackets Haley has, how many jackets does Anna have in terms of n?

A. n − 3
B. n + 3
C. 3 − n
D. 3n

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
answer.title: Answer
